name: an-added-test-file-must-be-measured
find:
if parts.name not in recorded:
            named.append(parts.name)
replace:
if parts.name not in recorded and recorded:
            named.append(parts.name)
breaks: a missing record reads as every added file being measured, so the check that names the branch owing a measurement passes hardest at the moment the record is gone (#1058, L98)
